title: TLS 1.1 accepted
detail: TLS 1.1 meets the minimum but is deprecated; TLS 1.2+ is recommended.
fix: Set the minimum protocol to TLS 1.2.

title: Sensitive page cacheable: /dashboard
detail: Cache-Control: private, max-age=0. `private` still allows browser caching.
fix: Send `Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` on every authenticated or token-handling response.

title: Cookie connect.sid missing httponly
detail: Looks like a session/auth cookie. Set-Cookie: connect.sid=s%3A…; Path=/; Secure
fix: Set `Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` on session cookies.

title: /oauth/callback returns HTML with tokens in the URL
fix: Handle the callback server-side and always answer with `302 Found`.

title: OAuth tokens or realmId written to logs
fix: Never log tokens, realmId, or QuickBooks payloads. Log a token fingerprint (last 4 chars) or a request id instead.

title: Encryption key hardcoded in source
fix: Load the AES key from a separate config file or secret manager (env var, AWS KMS, Vault) — Intuit requires it not be inline.

title: OAuth tokens sent to or stored in the browser
fix: Keep Intuit tokens server-side only. The browser should hold an opaque session cookie, never access/refresh tokens or realmId.

title: Cookie configured without Secure/HttpOnly
fix: Set secure: true and httpOnly: true for session cookies in every non-local environment.

locations.snippet: await db.query(`UPDATE companies SET refresh_token = '${authResponse.token.refresh_token}' WHERE realm = ${req.query.realmId}`);

title: OAuth state parameter is a constant
detail: The authorize URL uses a hardcoded `state` (Intuit's sample code ships `testState`). That disables CSRF protection on the connect flow.
fix: Generate a random state per request (crypto.randomBytes(32)), store it in the session, and compare it in the callback before exchanging the code.

title: No CSRF middleware detected
detail: No CSRF library or SameSite cookie config found. Intuit's pen test checks state-changing forms and endpoints.
fix: Add CSRF tokens (csrf-csrf, Django/Rails built-ins) or SameSite=Lax/Strict session cookies plus origin checks.

title: Refresh token stored without encryption
detail: Found code persisting the refresh token but no AES/3DES encryption anywhere in the codebase.
fix: Encrypt refresh token and realmId with AES-256-GCM before writing them (see README for a 20-line helper).

title: realmId stored without encryption
detail: Intuit requires realmId to be encrypted at rest along with the refresh token.
